type_xpac.sql: SELECT type, is_xpac, count(*) AS works, count_if(is_paratext IS TRUE) AS paratext_true, count_if(is_retracted IS TRUE) AS retracted_true FROM read_parquet('/mnt/hg02/openalex-snapshot/data/parquet/works/*/*.parquet') GROUP BY type,is_xpac ORDER BY type,is_xpac;

core_type_source.sql: SELECT type, primary_location.source.type AS source_type, count(*) AS works, count_if(is_paratext IS TRUE) AS paratext_true, count_if(is_retracted IS TRUE) AS retracted_true FROM read_parquet('/mnt/hg02/openalex-snapshot/data/parquet/works/*/*.parquet') WHERE is_xpac IS FALSE GROUP BY type,primary_location.source.type ORDER BY type,source_type;

example_sampling.method: five update-date strata, smallest Parquet file in each; illustrative, not representative

examples.sql: SELECT id,display_name,type,primary_location.source.type AS source_type,primary_location.source.display_name AS source_name,primary_location.raw_type AS raw_type,primary_location.version AS version,is_paratext,is_retracted,is_xpac FROM read_parquet(['/mnt/hg02/openalex-snapshot/data/parquet/works/updated_date=2016-06-24/part_0000.parquet','/mnt/hg02/openalex-snapshot/data/parquet/works/updated_date=2020-02-07/part_0000.parquet','/mnt/hg02/openalex-snapshot/data/parquet/works/updated_date=2025-10-19/part_0000.parquet','/mnt/hg02/openalex-snapshot/data/parquet/works/updated_date=2026-02-25/part_0001.parquet','/mnt/hg02/openalex-snapshot/data/parquet/works/updated_date=2026-06-26/part_0048.parquet']) WHERE is_xpac IS FALSE AND (type IN ('letter','editorial','book-chapter','other','preprint','erratum','retraction') OR (type='article' AND (primary_location.source.type='conference' OR is_paratext IS TRUE))) QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY type,primary_location.source.type ORDER BY id)<=3;
